items.Sentence: Petroleum products, grease, or scum shall not be visible on disposal ponds.

Collected screenings, sludges, and other solids removed from liquid wastes shall be disposed of in a manner consistent with Part 503 in Title 40 of the Code of Federal Regulations or Section 20005 et seq. of Title 27 of the California Code of Regulations and as approved by the Executive Officer.
